definitions.explanation: The distance between two opposite surfaces of something.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}の{厚|あつ}さは3センチだ。
examples.english: The thickness of this book is 3 centimeters.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}の{厚|あつ}さを{測|はか}る。
examples.english: To measure the thickness of the wall.

notes:
{厚|あつ}さ is a measurement noun derived from the adjective {厚|あつ}い (thick) + the nominalizing suffix さ. It expresses thickness as a measurable quantity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {厚|あつ}さ〜センチ: ~ centimeters thick
- {厚|あつ}さを{測|はか}る: to measure thickness
- {厚|あつ}さがある: to have thickness, to be thick

HOMOPHONE:
Do not confuse with {暑|あつ}さ (heat/hotness from weather), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.

RELATED MEASUREMENT NOUNS:
- {長|なが}さ: length (from {長|なが}い)
- {高|たか}さ: height (from {高|たか}い)
- {深|ふか}さ: depth (from {深|ふか}い)
- {広|ひろ}さ: area/spaciousness (from {広|ひろ}い)
- {重|おも}さ: weight (from {重|おも}い)

All follow the same い-adjective stem + さ pattern to create nouns expressing degree or measurement.
